sqlMap.select:
SELECT T.ITEM_NO, S1.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, CAL_ORDER, T.STA_ITEM_ID, T.DATATYPE, S2.CONTENT DATATYPE_NAME
FROM AR_STA_ITEM T, AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM PA, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S2 WHERE T.ITEM_NO = PA.ITEM_NO AND PA.ITEM_NO = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+) = #language:VARCHAR# AND T.DATATYPE = S2.NO(+) AND S2.LANGUAGE(+) = #language:VARCHAR# AND PA.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1 AND PA.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY PA.CAL_ORDER
SELECT ITEM_NO, FORMULAR_NO, CONDITION, FORMULAR FROM AR_STA_FORMULAR WHERE ITEM_NO=#ITEM_NO:VARCHAR# AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# ORDER BY FORMULAR_NO
SELECT T.FORMULAR_NO, T.ITEM_NO, T.CONDITION, T.FORMULAR, T.CPNY_ID FROM AR_STA_FORMULAR T WHERE T.FORMULAR_NO = #FORMULAR_NO:NUMERIC# AND T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.update: UPDATE AR_STA_FORMULAR SET CONDITION=#CONDITION:VARCHAR#, FORMULAR=#FORMULAR:VARCHAR#, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #UPDATED_BY:VARCHAR# WHERE FORMULAR_NO=#FORMULAR_NO:VARCHAR# AND ITEM_NO=#ITEM_NO:VARCHAR# AND CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.select: SELECT DISTINCT A.*, S2.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, S1.CONTENT ITEM_GROUP_NAME FROM AR_ITEM A, AR_ITEM_PARAM C, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S2 WHERE A.ITEM_NO = C.ITEM_NO AND C.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND A.ITEM_GROUP_CODE = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+) = #language:VARCHAR# AND A.ITEM_NO = S2.NO(+) AND S2.LANGUAGE(+) = #language:VARCHAR# ORDER BY A.ITEM_NO

SELECT DISTINCT_FIELD, S1.CONTENT FIELD_NAME FROM PA_DISTINCT_LIST, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1 WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'PA_HR_V' AND CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND ID = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+) = #language:VARCHAR# AND PA_DISTINCT_LIST.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY PA_DISTINCT_LIST.ORDERNO

select 'ATT_ITEM.' || ai.item_id as ID, ai.item_name_zh as name from ar_item ai union select 'STA_ITEM.' || asi.sta_item_id, asi.item_name_zh from ar_sta_item asi union select 'STA_ITEM.' || pdl.distinct_field, pdl.field_name_zh from pa_distinct_list pdl where pdl.table_name = 'PA_HR_V'

select 'ATT_ITEM.' || ai.item_id as ID, S1.CONTENT as name from ar_item ai,SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1 WHERE ai.item_no = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# union select 'STA_ITEM.' || asi.sta_item_id, S2.CONTENT AS name from ar_sta_item asi,SY_GLOBAL_NAME S2 WHERE asi.item_no = S2.NO(+) AND S2.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# union select 'STA_ITEM.' || pdl.distinct_field, S3.CONTENT AS name from pa_distinct_list pdl,SY_GLOBAL_NAME S3 WHERE pdl.table_name = 'PA_HR_V' and pdl.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# and pdl.ID = S3.NO(+) AND S3.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM AR_STA_FORMULAR WHERE FORMULAR_NO=#FORMULAR_NO:VARCHAR# AND CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
